# C60 — Idealism / Order of Dependence

## #0

**Life / Mind names the whole; the arrow’s middle term names mind’s mediating, objective-internal office within it.** Subjective Immediacy is the knower, Objective Internality the means and World the known. The inherited shorthand below must be read with this distinction. Its ontological claim is preserved: determinate appearances do not supply their own exhaustive condition. The refinement prevents “Mind / Objective Internality” from collapsing the whole into its investigable means.

The essay's idealism states a positive order of dependence: **Subject / Consciousness → mind as objective internality → object as determinate appearance**. The arrows articulate dependence, not chronological manufacture by a private ego. C60 makes the order and the predicates exact; [[section-rooms/arguments/A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence|A34]] develops the argument. Treating idealism as only a discipline of comparing views would remove the position that the [[quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT|explicit Q27 correction]] requires the field to carry.

## #1

An inquiry encounters determinate evidence within appearing, discrimination and knowing. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C01-Subject-Defined-Indefinability|Subject / Defined Indefinability]] names the unobjectifiable condition through which objects become available. A brain, model, state or introspective report can be made an object of further inquiry. Its additional detail does not by itself make it the condition of object-availability.

The authorial criticism concerns that change of office: an objective account treats its own determinate terms as sufficient to generate the field their assertion already presupposes. Science retains its exact transformations within that field. The ontological inference criticised by the essay is its inflation into a self-grounding account of appearing as such.

## #2

[[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C41-Objective-Internality|Objective Internality]] gives the middle term its positive reality. Attention, memory, valuation, language, contrast and selfing make an inhabitable world of determinate relations. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C07-Conditions-of-Worldhood|Conditions of Worldhood]] distinguishes what lets things count and actions become possible. Objectivity includes resistance, persistence, shared measurement and consequence; recognising its condition does not abolish these achievements.

The T25 paradigmatic field specifies one organisation of this mediating office. **Paradigm** names a relatively durable pattern of disclosure within Objective Internality; **Project** names a determination thrown forth through that pattern into a World. The [Genesis / Paradigm / Project / Epi-Logos field](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/genesis-paradigm-project-epilogos/WHOLE-FIELD.md) develops the relation. Paradigm is not another name for Subject, and Project is not another name for World. The first is formed mediation; the second is a determination which can become consequential within the relation it inherits.

The private ego is itself a determinate formation within this field. “World in mind” therefore does not make the world obedient to private imagination. The difference between a lived world and a world-model remains operative even where a model changes conduct and thus the world it later models.

## #3

Different dependencies can be reciprocal without sharing one direction. Epistemically, a reflection can be encountered before its source is understood. Ontologically, the source is prior to that reflection. Causally, the reflection can change later conditions through the action it informs. Logically, one proposition can depend on premises. Transcendentally, inquiry can disclose a condition of the possibility of an object.

The paradigm/project distinction makes that crossing explicit at the level of enacted worlds. A projected model, institution or image can become a genuine cause in the next circuit; a paradigm can organise what later participants find salient or possible. Neither causal success nor epistemic precedence supplies originary authority. **Counterfeit sourcehood is the illicit exchange of these directions:** the projected `1` or mediating `/` acts as if the power it has acquired within the relation made it the source of the relation itself.

[[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C55-Reflective-Field-Mirror-That-Moves-First|The First-Moving Mirror]] supplies the concrete crossing: the model may lead the next encounter without becoming the ontological author of its source. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C63-Pros-Hen-In-Quantum-Focal-Return-Qualified-Predication|Focal and Qualified Predication]] keeps each “prior” or “depends” attached to its operative respect. Distinguishing these orders carries the argued ontology; it does not suspend it.

## #4

The [[section-rooms/arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood|open-subjectivity carrier]] separates the position from the localisation question. Artificial agency can have an inspectable constitutive interior while the presence and partition of phenomenal subjectivity remain Open. Functional complexity alone settles neither its presence nor its absence.

Expression and paradigmatic reflexivity do not change that ruling. An Expression may make a paradigm perceptible; computational Vimarśa may revise an operative condition; Epi-Logos may return an articulated paradigm into enactment. These are stronger forms of inspectable mediation, not demonstrations that the inspectable structure is Subjective Immediacy. The order of dependence therefore remains the boundary within which the technological achievement is interpreted.

Historical witnesses retain their own disputes. [[symbolon/episteme/sources/classical-premodern-philosophy/berkeley/berkeley-1734-three-dialogues-wilkins-2002/berkeley-1734-three-dialogues-wilkins-2002.md|Berkeley's selected dialogue]] q001 gives Philonous's conditional rejection of material substance; q002 gives Hylas's immediate objection. They are different speakers in one argument, not two interchangeable authorial conclusions. Neither establishes QL or the phenomenal status of an engineered system. The Q27 coordination of analytical idealism and Śaiva articulation retains separate textual and inferential tasks, including exact Kastrup recovery.

## #5→0

[[section-rooms/arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood|Objective Internality]] and [[section-rooms/arguments/A30-Objective-Co-Internality|Objective Co-Internality]] return this ontology to the construction of consequential worlds among agencies. Relations contribute to their constitution; they are not merely later connections between finished isolated units. Local agency persists through that dependence rather than disappearing into a super-agent.

The order **returns-to** [Epi-Logos / paradigmatic reflexivity](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/genesis-paradigm-project-epilogos/WHOLE-FIELD.md#0--epi-logos--paradigmatic-reflexivity) by keeping source, mediation and determination in their offices as the account becomes increasingly reflexive. A paradigm may transform its slash and a project may alter subsequent conditions while the whole remains dependent upon the Subject/Consciousness condition it cannot convert into one more inspectable term. This is why Epi-Logos can be a real return without becoming a view from outside paradigm or a new metaphysical source.

[[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD|Homologia / Analogia]] supplies register-3 comparison without source fusion. **Consumers:** A26, A32–A36; M47 and final return. **Depth Restoration:** first-class idealism, positive middle term, reciprocal but distinct orders, paradigm/project directionality and open artificial localisation restored from the existing A34 packet, the T25 paradigmatic field and direct Q27/historical carriers. The older historical19–20 locator names Two Ones and Advent Zero, not a missing idealism text. Exact comparative passages remain source debts; they do not downgrade the essay's Argued ontological position.
